=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1909 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR removes setup_serena.sh from the fetched support scripts in .github/workflows/validate.yml line 280, but validate_process.sh still unconditionally invokes it.
  WHY: The file `scripts/setup_serena.sh` will not exist on disk because the workflow no longer fetches it. bash will emit `scripts/setup_serena.sh: No such file or directory` to stderr on every validation run. The `|| true` prevents the pipeline from failing, but the error pollutes logs and demonstrates incomplete cleanup. This is a straightforward file-not-found error that is guaranteed to occur on every validation execution.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:448 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The workflow still fetches serena-efficiency-block.txt alongside the prompt files.
  WHY: `render_prompt.sh` (still fetched at line 280) requires this file to exist and extracts [READ_ONLY] and [READ_WRITE] sections from it to expand `{{SERENA_EFFICIENCY_BLOCK_READ_ONLY}}` and `{{SERENA_EFFICIENCY_BLOCK_READ_WRITE}}` placeholders. The five validation prompt files still contain `{{SERENA_EFFICIENCY_BLOCK_READ_ONLY}}`.
- prompts/mode-validate-discover.txt:43 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The discover validation prompt still contains this placeholder.
  WHY: `validate_process.sh` line 2046 renders this prompt through `render_prompt.sh`, which expands it into Serena MCP instructions.
- prompts/mode-validate-diagnose.txt:207 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Same as above — validate_process.sh line 2699 renders this prompt through `render_prompt.sh`.
  WHY: Same as above — model receives instructions for unavailable tools.
- prompts/mode-validate-generate.txt:811 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The generate prompt contains this placeholder but is never individually rendered through `render_prompt.sh`.
  WHY: It is included raw in the self-heal context by `self_heal_validation.sh`, passing the literal placeholder text to the model. This is inconsistent with the discover/diagnose prompts which do get the expansion. The placeholder has no functional purpose in a MCP-free validation path.
- prompts/mode-validate-fix-harness.txt:285 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Same as generate — the fix-harness prompt contains this placeholder, is never individually rendered, and passes literal placeholder text to the model in self-heal context.
  WHY: Same inconsistency as generate — the model sees raw placeholder text.
- prompts/mode-validate-self-heal.txt:79-81,83 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The self-heal prompt contains both the placeholder and an explicit guard forbidding its removal.
  WHY: The self-heal mechanism, if triggered, cannot remove Serena placeholders even if a model correctly identifies them as obsolete. This makes the validation path self-contradictory — the workflow removes Serena but the prompts and their safety guards preserve it.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:12-14 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The header comment documents these Serena/MCP environment variables as expected inputs.
  WHY: The workflow no longer passes them, and the script does not actually use these variables in its code — they were only consumed by setup_serena.sh, which is no longer called successfully. This is a documentation-only issue.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
